**UI/QA Review: Puget Sound Analytics Map (Desktop, Light Mode)**

| # | Check Item | Status | Details |
|---|------------|--------|---------|
| **1** | **Six Market Dot Labels** (Shoreline, Sammamish, Issaquah, Snoqualmie, Bainbridge Island, Vashon Island) | **FAIL** | **Vashon Island label is clipped at the bottom edge** of the map container. The dot is visible, but the text "Vashon Island" and its subtext are cut off. All other 5 labels (Shoreline, Sammamish, Issaquah, Snoqualmie, Bainbridge Island) are fully legible with no overlapping of dots or other labels. |
| **2** | **Ferry Route Labels** | **PASS** | The "ferry" labels (in teal script font) along the dashed lines to Bainbridge Island and Vashon Island are legible and do not overlap with market labels or dots. |
| **3** | **KPI Tiles Under Map** | **N/A** | KPI tiles are not visible in the provided screenshot (the image cuts off at the bottom of the map area). Cannot verify values or alignment. |
| **4** | **Timeline Scrubber** | **N/A** | A timeline scrubber component is not visible in the provided screenshot. Cannot verify rendering. |

---

### **Overall Verdict: FAIL**

**Reason for Failure:** Item 1 failed due to the **clipped "Vashon Island" label** at the bottom boundary of the map viewport. This is a layout/overflow bug that prevents users from reading the full market name and its associated metric without scrolling (if scrollable) or interacting further.

**Recommendation:** Adjust the map's view bounds or padding to ensure the Vashon Island label (and any other peripheral markers) renders fully within the visible container.
